name: FEI YOUNG
detail: Taijutsu only. "I can't cast a gijutsu, but I can damn sure punch one." Longer reach and heavier normals, no projectile, and the best approach speed in the slice. Where Tsu answers pressure, Fei applies it.
appearance: Fei Young, a loud athletic young brawler in the blue Yokai Honno Academy school uniform: a cerulean blue blazer with pale trim over a white collared shirt, the red necktie flung over one shoulder, wild spiky dark hair, bare clenched fists, tan trousers, dark brown shoes

reference.note: Yokai Honno Academy character sheet, front view. Measured by tools/ai/ref_palette.py. The tie region is the flung tie rather than the knot: he is drawn with the knot at his throat and the rest of the tie horizontal, and the flung part is the larger sample of the same red.

front.shows: front standing view, tie flying over the shoulder

back.shows: back standing view, tie flying clear of the body

three_quarter.shows: narrow profile view; this sheet has no plain side view, this is the closest

face_neutral.shows: the front view's own head. This sheet has no separate neutral panel and every expression panel on it is extreme, so the neutral face is read off the standing view

face_shock.shows: head + collar, whites showing, sweat drops

face_laugh.shows: head + collar, eyes shut, mouth wide open

pose_sprint.shows: running, arms and legs at full stretch

pose_stance.shows: low wide stance, both hands near the floor

pose_kick.shows: spinning back-kick. The shockwave burst around the foot is disconnected line art, so the trim drops it -- and because it is dropped the box is cut back to the figure rather than left with the burst's empty half
